ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure, with a benzene ring on the left; the benzene ring is connected to the central carbon, and the central carbon is also connected to one hydrogen, one sulfur atom, and the imine/iminium carbon on the right. The sulfur atom is connected to a six-membered morpholine-like ring containing N and O above. At the lower right there is also a positively charged six-membered morpholine-like ring containing N and O, with N connected to the iminium carbon above; this iminium carbon is also connected to a methyl group. The curved arrows in the figure only indicate electron movement and are not counted as bonds. Reasoning: Count non-hydrogen bonds according to the specified partition. The benzene ring has 6 intraring bonds; the upper morpholine-like N/O ring has 6 intraring bonds; the lower morpholine-like N+/O ring has 6 intraring bonds. Then count the non-ring bonds between fragments: phenyl to central carbon 1, central carbon to S 1, central carbon to iminium carbon 1, S to upper N 1, iminium carbon to lower N 1, iminium carbon to methyl carbon 1, for a total of 6. The central C-H bond is excluded, and arrows are not counted. Therefore the total is 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 24.

method.method_draft: Tally heavy-atom degrees from the drawing.
